notes: PAPER LICENCE: CC BY 4.0; Europe PMC records licence 'cc by' for PMC6472396 and Unpaywall reports oa_status 'gold' with a cc-by publisher location. PDF archived. DATA LICENCE, separate and materially different from the paper licence: the data are NOT under a Creative Commons licence. They are held in the Donders Institute data repository and released only under a Data Use Agreement, quoted from the paper: 'potentially identifying data (such as imaging data) recorded at the Donders Centre for Cognitive Neuroimaging can only be shared to researchers following explicit approval of a Data Use Agreement (DUA), hence the requirement for registration and requesting access. Neither the authors nor the data manager is involved in granting access to specific external researchers, this is only based on the complete registration of the researcher and follows a click-through procedure.' Ownership is stated as the Max Planck Institute for Psycholinguistics, Neurobiology of Language department. So: open-access paper, agreement-gated data. RETRIEVAL TRAP WORTH RECORDING: a Europe PMC free-text search for the title, and a search for the PMCID PMC6447566, both resolved to the wrong record -- the Publisher Correction (10.1038/s41597-019-0050-5, PMC6486580, 2,311 characters) rather than the article. The fielded query DOI:"10.1038/s41597-019-0020-y" resolved correctly to PMC6472396. Free-text search against Europe PMC is not reliable for disambiguating an article from its own correction notice. EXTRACTION: source.md built from the Europe PMC full-text XML. md_quality is rough -- the article's tables (the stimulus inventory and the per-modality acquisition parameters) flatten into pipe rows without headers, and the figures showing the MEG source-level results survive only as captions. The word-duration formula and the additional-channel list quoted on the card come from body prose and Usage Notes respectively, and were read back against source.pdf.
